name: Fork Agent
description: Forks an existing agent — creates a new agent with the same config and state as the source. The forked agent starts SLEEPING with fresh tasks, pending, and inbox collections; timeline is copied only if includeTimeline is true. Use for branching exploration (try different prompts from a common starting point), scaling (spawn parallel workers from a trained agent), or snapshots before risky operations. Optional config accepts one layer or an ordered layer array; it is resolved first, then recursively merged over the source config with later values winning.

sourceId.description: Source agent reference: bare, g/<id>, /g/<id>, or <ownerDID>/g/<id>; it must exist and not be TERMINATED

agentId.description: Target agent reference: bare, g/<id>, /g/<id>, or <ownerDID>/g/<id>; it must not already exist

config.description: Optional config override layer(s): inline map, reference, or ordered array of both. Resolved and recursively merged on top of the source agent's config. Array entries must each be a map or string reference; null is not a layer (put null inside a map to clear an inherited field).

includeTimeline.description: If true, copy the source agent's timeline (run history). Default false.

forkedFrom.description: Local ID of the source agent
